cohort: Participants were 31,385 new users of intrauterine devices (IUDs) at a family planning clinic.
finding: Sociodemographic characteristics of IUD users changed significantly over time, with LNG-IUS users more likely to be older than 40, have fewer years of schooling, and be nulligravidas compared to Cu-IUD users in the later period.
cross-section timing: Data covered IUD insertions performed between 1979 and 2006 (Cu-IUD only) and between 2007 and 2019 (both Cu-IUD and LNG-IUS).
